museum_gallery.issue: The 3-second hook does not read as 'gloved hand wiping museum glass'. f6-f72: a puffy, segmented, mannequin-white glove slides in flat from frame right, fingers horizontal, and rotates upright by 3.0 s in a pure black void. (5) Salt: 6-8 faceted 2-4 px crystals clustered in the cleared band x 0.55-0.70, each twinkling for 3-5 frames as the spot catches them, starting 2.75 s. museum_gallery.issue: The three-vitrine track, CH1's spectacle and the S066 preview, renders as black: 82-85% of every frame is below 4% and the mean is ~2%. Put a cast-iron column between each pair of cases with a silver moon edge, and add a cool bounce on the north wall so the brick and columns read at 8-12% (never 0). Target per frame: mean at least 7%, at most 35% of pixels below 4%. Layer each pane: the real contents at 30-40% (G3a needle-route book + sounding lead; G3b empty mount + shards; G3c open case), the era plane above them (raise strength from 0.10-0.42 to 0.25 entering and 0.60 centred), and a diagonal moon glint running from the upper right to the lower left of each pane. Rim-light her with the doorway moon as she walks behind the dolly, so her reflection reads at x ~0.40 as a dark silhouette with a silver edge at ~15-20% of the era brightness. Lower the cabin plate ~0.12 m so the navigator's head sits inside the pane. Use a lower angle in view_pier so the crate and her knees under the case read as seated. Ease out the dolly over the last 0.9 s so G3c centres at 89.36 and holds at x 0.45-0.55 until the cut (90.04). Black must never fill more than 30% of the frame. Keep the cut to S025 (she walks back to G3b), but update S025's transition note to match.

Check every first and last frame of S023-S030 against those targets.

museum_gallery.issue: The audience cannot tell that this is the future or that the coat is HERS. S070 enters the dissolve already on a high-angle medium of the whole folded coat.
